title: BusinessSignalPattern
description: The BUSINESS_SIGNAL entity produced by src/business_integration.py create_business_signal_entity(): a pattern/opportunity claim derived FROM one or more BusinessObservation records (see derived_from_observation_ids), never a raw fact itself. NOTE (naming debt, flagged for owner sign-off): this is the entity EXTERNAL_INTEGRATION.md's 5.1/5.2 sections describe as 'BUSINESS_SIGNAL'. A separate, structurally different record produced by ingest_business_signal() is ALSO informally called a business signal and validates against business_signal.schema.json; the two are not interchangeable. Ideally one of the two would be renamed (e.g. ingest_business_signal's output is arguably BusinessObservation-shaped) -- left as-is here to avoid a wide rename across call sites/tests without explicit owner sign-off.
